description: Sales for a period: orders, revenue and net revenue after refunds, average order value, units, unique customers, change against the previous period (or last year), a day/week/month series, top products, countries and discount codes. Amounts are per currency; canceled and draft orders are excluded. Clients that support MCP Apps show it as an interactive dashboard.
